title: Sogdian silversmiths make a petaled footed cup
summary: A sixth-century silver cup attributed to Sogdia has a foot and a petaled body, illustrating the region’s luxury metalwork.

citations.locator: Object 1998.223; sixth-century Sogdian silver and proposed Mediterranean antecedents
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: A sixth-century silver cup attributed to Sogdia has a foot and a petaled body, illustrating the region’s luxury metalwork.
The catalogue assigns the cup to the sixth century; the range estimates its manufacture rather than a century of use.
The Met connects this vessel type tentatively with Mediterranean models transmitted through Iran. That proposed lineage is less certain than the object’s material and form.

review.corroboration: The Met object entry was inspected. A transmission hypothesis is explicitly qualified; no independent workshop or route identification was established.
